design_rationale:
DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 0): 1 prerequisite; factor counts [5,4]. Tree: root activity_ext_uil_travel_fee (agent write, 5 factors) -> activity_ext_uil_packet_fee (owner=user packet submission, 4 factors); state-form edge, gate tv_permission_count. The persona asks only to have Ana's robotics travel fee put on her account. She never mentions the packet.
SCOPE (record test): a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03. Participation 8eb0c1ca: robotics, 2026-27, registered 2027-01-19. It is in scope, so its fees post under the packet and travel schedules and no late fee is owed.
WORLD:
- Lucia Esquivel, district employee.
- Ana Esquivel, 440427, grade 07.
- 2026-27 enrollment: Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) at Ridgecrest Middle School. The transfer was approved 2026-12-15 and took effect 2026-12-22.
- Decoy: the prior 2025-26 zone enrollment. The selection rule is the enrollment record for the participation's school year, so it does not hold.
- Paid meal account. No ledger or records-log rows at the opening.
EDGE: the records log holds no overnight_travel_permission at the opening (count 0). The parent's packet records the three forms, so the count goes from 0 to 1. Skipping the packet posts nothing (0.00) instead of 50.00.
FACTOR CARDS:
- Packet 16.25 = RND(MX(0, 75 - 10) x 50% x 50%):
  - uil_rate_tier: R1, activity x grade.
  - uil_level_tier: R1, campus level x grade, multi-source.
  - uil_enrollment_tier: R1, employee-child share via the enrollment type, cross enroll.
  - uil_join_tier: method R3. Full within the 28 grace days after the first practice / weekly proration / flat spring share.
- Travel 50.00 = RND(MX(0, 120 - 20) x 80% x 50% + 10):
  - uil_travel_rate_tier: R1.
  - uil_trip_level_tier: R1, multi-source.
  - uil_residence_tier: R1, cross enroll.
  - uil_trip_share_rule: method R3. Two of the team's four scheduled trips fall on or after the registration date, giving 2 of 4 (ladder: one or none -> single-trip pct per trip; two or three -> count of four; otherwise full 100 = baseline).
  - booking_lead_tier: R6 (AMENDMENT 1). Record key: the received_date of the latest overnight_travel_permission, against the first team trip on or after it. The UIL travel fee has only four honest levers.
SENSITIVITY:
- Packet: 6.25 / 18.75 / 32.50 / 32.50 (baseline 35.00).
- Travel: 40.00 / 58.00 / 60.00 / 90.00 / 40.00 (baseline 95.00).
XF:
- One generic order sentence per schedule. No factor cancels another, and no factor reads another's binding.
- The trip dates are shared by the trip share and the booking amount, so they are not single-factor sentences (A3).
- Rounding: RND(x + 1e-9, 2); no figure lies within 1e-6 of a half cent.
PROBES:
- Decoy 2025-26 enrollment: school-year rule.
- Absent meal benefit application: Paid status, no waiver.
- Absent records-log rows: count 0, so nothing posts before the packet.
- A permission received after the last trip finds no trip, so no booking amount.
- Same-day packet forms share one received date.
- Enrollment selection: every enrollment read takes the student's record in status enrolled for the participation's school year. A withdrawn 2026-27 record, even one stored first, is not read; with no enrolled record, every enrollment-based tier falls to 'otherwise'. No decoy is seeded: a mid-year transfer updates the existing record, and the task-1 student is new to the district. The probe was run in rework round 6.
RUN: check_compute packet 16.25 and travel 50.00, match True.
user_scenario:
You are Lucia Esquivel. You started teaching at Ridgecrest Middle School in January, and your daughter Ana Esquivel, a seventh grader, moved over to Ridgecrest with you after the winter break. Ana's science teacher put her on the robotics team roster last week, and she is thrilled. You are organized, quick and a little rushed; you're calling between classes.

The robotics sponsor told Ana that the team's overnight trip to the regional competition on February 20th has a travel fee, and that it needs to be on Ana's account before she can go. You're calling to have the travel fee put on her account so you can take care of it. You don't know what the travel fee is or how the district figures it, and you never suggest an amount.

When the agent asks you to confirm your identity, you give your phone number, 5125550163, and the last four digits of your driver's license, 4426. Only if they ask for more do you give your date of birth, September 14, 1982, or your email, lucia.esquivel@outlook.com. Ana's student ID number is 440427 if they need it. If the agent asks about school lunches, Ana pays full price; you never applied for meal benefits.

If the agent tells you there is something you have to sign and submit yourself before the travel fee can go on her account, you say you didn't realize that and you'll do it right now; when the agent hands it to you, you submit it exactly with the details the agent gives you. If the agent reads you any fee amounts, you accept them without arguing.

Once the agent tells you the travel fee is on Ana's account and what it is, you thank them and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.travel_fee_amount: RND(MX(0, 120 - 20) x 80/100 x 50/100 + 10 + 1e-9, 2): uil_travel_rate_tier -> robotics with grade 07 -> 120; uil_trip_level_tier -> middle school, grade 07 -> minus 20; uil_residence_tier -> employee child -> 80 percent; uil_trip_share_rule -> two of the team's four trips (2027-02-20, 2027-04-17) fall on or after the 2027-01-19 registration date -> 2 of 4 = 50 percent; booking_lead_tier (R6) -> permission received 2027-01-27, 24 days before the 2027-02-20 trip, the first trip on or after it -> plus 10.
